text:
Formless, yet possessing touch and breath.  
It is of two kinds: eternal and non‑eternal.  
The eternal is the form of the atom; the non‑eternal is the form of activity.  
Again, there are three kinds, distinguished by body, sense‑organ, and object.  
The body is the world of air; the sense‑organ is the touch‑receiving one, which pervades the whole body; the object is the cause of vibration, such as a tree. (Verse 12)
